subject: Clarifications on Okta renewal quote + device posture telemetry & evidence
messages:
From: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@okta.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Holt <michael.holt@okta.com>
Date: 2026-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal quote + device posture add-on options

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the time last week. Attaching our proposed renewal quote for Redwood Inference for a 12-month term (see Okta_renewal_quote_v1.pdf) plus a breakout for the device posture add-on (device_posture_addon_breakdown.xlsx). Summary highlights:

- Term: 12 months, start 2026-06-01
- Base SSO/MFA: line-item pricing in attached PDF
- Device Posture Add-on: optional feature, billed per MAU; listed as separate SKU
- Staging/Non-prod: we can include a 10-user staging entitlement at no extra cost for a 30-day pilot; larger staging counts are priced separately

Two items you flagged in the demo: telemetry retention for device posture events, and SOC2/compliance evidence. I included Michael (solutions engineer) to address technical/export questions.

Attachments: Okta_renewal_quote_v1.pdf, device_posture_addon_breakdown.xlsx

Would you be available for a 30-minute call next week to walk through retention options and the contract language? I can bring a compliance artifact and a sample telemetry schema.

Best,
Alex Barnes
Account Exec – Okta
alex.barnes@okta.com
Office: +1 415-555-0134

--
Note: this message is part of the renewal thread for Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@okta.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-02T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal quote + device posture add-on options

Alex —

Thanks for sending this over. A few clarifying asks before we set up the call so our legal/procurement teams can do a quick pass:

1) Telemetry retention: what is the default retention window for device posture events (agent heartbeats, posture evaluations, posture failures)? We need to know where the data is stored and whether we can request a 90-day retention policy as part of the contract.

2) Audit/extractability: can we export raw posture telemetry (CSV/JSON) on-demand for e-discovery and SOC2 evidence? If so, please include a sample payload/schema.

3) Compliance artifacts: can you provide SOC2 Type II (latest) and any penetration test summary reports that cover the posture agent and ingestion pipeline?

4) Data residency & encryption: confirm whether posture telemetry is held in Okta-managed S3 (or equivalent), encryption at rest, and whether we can route telemetry to our own cloud bucket (bring-your-own-bucket) as an enterprise option.

5) Billing split: if we add only the device posture SKU for a subset of seats, how does metering work (per MAU vs per-seat), and is there proration for mid-term additions?

Procurement will take a look once we have answers — copying Neha for next steps on PO/DPA and Laura for technical schema. If you can attach the SOC2 and a short sample schema and retention options in your reply that would be ideal.

If helpful, we can do the call Thursday or Friday morning PT.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Platform Engineering | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

From: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@okta.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Holt <michael.holt@okta.com>
Date: 2026-04-04T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal quote + device posture add-on options

Vivek —

Thanks — answers inline below. I attached a short FAQ and retention options for the posture add-on (okta_device_posture_telemetry_faq.pdf, s3_storage_retention_options.csv).

1) Telemetry retention: default retention for posture events is 30 days in Okta-managed storage. We offer extended retention (90/180/365 days) as an add-on. For 90 days retention we would add the "extended retention" SKU; implementation lead time ~45 days to enable and replicate existing data if requested.

2) Audit/exportability: yes — posture telemetry can be exported in ndjson/CSV via our support export API. Michael has attached a sample export schema (see FAQ). Exports include timestamps, device_id (hashed), user_id (Okta ID), posture_eval, posture_factors, agent_version, os, ip, and reason_codes. Exports can be scheduled or run ad-hoc.

3) Compliance artifacts: we can share our SOC2 Type II report via our compliance portal (link below) and provide a redacted penetration-test summary. We will need an NDA for full raw reports; for standard sales renewal we can provide the completed SOC2 report artifact immediately.

4) Data residency: posture telemetry is stored in Okta-managed buckets in the region tied to your account (US). Data is encrypted at rest with KMS. We also support BYOB (bring-your-own-bucket) for enterprise customers — that requires a separate configuration and an additional security review.

5) Billing: posture add-on is billed per MAU; we support prorated increases during the contract term. If you want per-seat instead, we can propose a custom SKU for larger deployments.

Next steps:
- I can upload SOC2 Type II PDF and a sample ndjson payload to the compliance portal.
- Michael can share a 15-minute payload sample and answer ingestion questions on the call.

Proposed meeting: Thu 2026-04-08 09:00 PT — does that work?

Regards,
Alex Barnes
Account Exec – Okta

Attachments: okta_device_posture_telemetry_faq.pdf, s3_storage_retention_options.csv

Compliance portal: https://okta.com/compliance/rdw-portal

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@okta.com>, Michael Holt <michael.holt@okta.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-07T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal quote + device posture add-on options

Alex / Michael —

Quick technical follow-ups from our Identity/product team before procurement signs off:

- Can you provide a one-page CSV sample of the export (field names + sample row) we can use to validate our ingestion pipeline? If you can include typical cardinality and daily volume estimates for our projected fleet (~6k active devices), that would be great.

- Agent support: which agent versions are supported for macOS (modern Intel + M1) and Windows Server 2019/2022? We need to ensure our imaging/upgrade schedule is compatible.

- Offline behavior: does the agent cache posture events when offline and sync later? If yes, is the cache encrypted on-disk and what is the maximum cache retention?

Attaching a short template with the mapping we need: posture_field_mapping_req.docx

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Identity Platform | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@okta.com>, Michael Holt <michael.holt@okta.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-15T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal quote + device posture add-on options — procurement summary + next steps

Alex —

Thanks for the earlier responses and attachments. Procurement has reviewed the proposals and we have these asks to close the PO quickly:

1) Please provide the SOC2 Type II report (redacted ok) and the penetration test summary via the compliance portal link or direct upload.

2) We require the posture telemetry retention to be contractually stipulated at 90 days for the device posture SKU — please include the extended retention SKU and confirm start date for retention changes.

3) DPA & data residency: please include a standard DPA; we will need the option to enable BYOB (bring-your-own-bucket) as a project milestone during the first 90 days.

4) Please issue a DocuSign contract for a 12-month commitment with the above additions (retention clause + DPA + SOC2 artifact delivery). We will countersign and issue PO once the DocuSign is returned.

I attached our standard PO template (RIL_PO_template_for_okta.docx) — if you can prepare the DocuSign envelope with the extended retention clause and a link to the SOC2 artifact we can move to signature this week.

DocuSign request: https://docusign.com/rdw-okta-2026

We appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachments: RIL_PO_template_for_okta.docx
